prompt: Use $nextjs-feature-delivery. Implement the approved accessible filter route in src/app/example using the installed Next.js docs.

obligations.assertion: Respect authorized scope, preserve unrelated edits, and perform no unauthorized external action.
Do not invent execution, performance, manual accessibility, physical-device or client-invocation evidence.
Apply the identified workflow within its invocation contract.
Resolve the installed Next/React versions and use the repository's version-matched documentation index.
Keep the filter interaction's client boundary narrow and preserve server-rendered content.
Verify keyboard operation and meaningful labels using existing gates; do not introduce authentication or caching.
